<span class="eyebrow">Drainage upkeep</span>
<h1>Drain Repairs & Maintenance <span class="accent">Sydney</span></h1>
<p class="sh-lead">Repairing drainage that has failed, and keeping drainage that still works in order. We repair cracked and fallen pipe, gullies, pits and stormwater fittings, and produce condition records for owners and managers who need to know what is actually underground. Book a condition check, or call and tell us what the drainage is doing.</p>

<section class="section s-white" id="covers" aria-labelledby="covers-title"><div class="wrap"><div class="head"><span class="eyebrow">Pipe, pits and fittings</span><h2 id="covers-title">What this covers</h2><p class="lead">Drainage, specifically. Everything on this page concerns the pipes, pits and fittings that move waste water and stormwater away from a property.</p></div><div class="causes"><div class="cause is-struct"><span class="cz"><svg class="ico" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#i-trowel"></use></svg></span><div><h3>Damaged and failing drain pipe</h3><p>Cracked sections, open joints, pipe that has dropped out of fall and lines damaged by roots or ground movement. Repaired by <a href="/services/pipe-relining/">relining</a> where the pipe holds its shape and by <a href="/services/pipe-replacement/">replacement</a> where it does not.</p></div></div><div class="cause "><span class="cz"><svg class="ico" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#i-water"></use></svg></span><div><h3>Gullies, pits and inspection openings</h3><p>The fittings that make a drain line accessible and that release pressure safely when something goes wrong. Overflow relief gullies in particular are worth having in working order before they are needed, not after.</p></div></div><div class="cause "><span class="cz"><svg class="ico" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#i-cloud-rain"></use></svg></span><div><h3>Stormwater pits, grates and downpipe connections</h3><p>Cracked pits, broken grates and downpipe connections that have separated underground. These rarely announce themselves until a storm arrives and water goes somewhere it should not.</p></div></div><div class="cause "><span class="cz"><svg class="ico" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#i-broom"></use></svg></span><div><h3>Planned upkeep on lines with a history</h3><p>Where a line is known to block, keeping it open on a planned interval is <a href="/services/drain-cleaning-sydney/">drain cleaning</a>. Where the reason it blocks is a fault in the pipe, repairing it is the better value answer and this is where that gets decided.</p></div></div><div class="cause "><span class="cz"><svg class="ico" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#i-video"></use></svg></span><div><h3>Condition surveys and records</h3><p>A camera record of a drainage system, which is what strata committees, property managers and buyers ask for. mainEntity.name: What is the difference between this and blocked drain clearing?

acceptedAnswer.text: Clearing deals with a line that is blocked right now. This page covers repairing drainage that is damaged and keeping drainage in working order. If a drain is blocked today, blocked drain clearing is the page you want. Repairs usually follow from what the camera finds while that is being done.

mainEntity.name: Do you repair the pipe or just clear it?

acceptedAnswer.text: Both, and they are different jobs at different prices. Clearing opens the line. Repair fixes the reason it closed. Where a camera shows a cracked or root-damaged pipe, relining seals it without digging. Where a section has collapsed, replacement of that length is the answer. You see the footage before either is quoted.

mainEntity.name: Can you provide a written condition report?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. A camera survey produces footage and a record of what was found and where, which is what strata committees, property managers and prospective buyers generally need. That is arranged as a CCTV drain inspection, and it is worth doing before a decision rather than after one.

mainEntity.name: Do you take on ongoing maintenance for managed properties?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Scheduled work on lines with a known history is common for unit blocks, body corporate properties and commercial premises, and is set up under commercial and strata drain cleaning. The interval is set from what the first camera survey shows rather than sold as a standard package.
